raw_ocr_text.text: BISWAJIT ACHARYA
Bhubaneswar, Odisha | +91-6370672482 | acharyabiswajit29@gmail.com
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Computer Science and Engineering graduate with hands-on experience in Python, FastAPI, Django, REST APIs, MySQL, JavaScript,
HTML, CSS, and Tailwind CSS. Experienced in cybersecurity-focused applications, document and PDF workflows, cyber-fraud awareness,
verification concepts, emergency support systems, and structured data-processing projects. Exposure to CDR/SDR workflows, call-detail
records, tollgate-related data, API-based backend development, and database-driven applications. Strong foundation in backend
development, SQL, web technologies, problem solving, and user-focused software solutions.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
• Programming: Python, JavaScript
• Backend: FastAPI, Django, REST API, Python Web Development, API Integration
• Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS
• Database: MySQL, SQL, Database Design, CRUD Operations
• Cybersecurity: Cybersecurity Fundamentals, Cyber Fraud Awareness, Document Verification
• Data & Documents: PDF Processing, Document Workflows, CDR, SDR, Call Detail Records, Structured Data Processing
• Tools: Git, GitHub, Visual Studio Code, MySQL Workbench
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
CR Cyber Crime Foundation | DLF Cybercity, Bhubaneswar
Project & Development Experience
• Contributed to technology and cybersecurity-focused initiatives involving structured information systems, document workflows, and
user-support solutions.
• Developed and worked on web-based project concepts using Python, FastAPI, Django, REST APIs, MySQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript,
and Tailwind CSS.
• Worked with document and PDF-oriented workflows for information handling, verification-oriented processing, structured records, and
support applications.
• Worked on CR-OD Nexora-related workflows involving CDR/SDR-style records, call-detail information, tollgate-related records, and
structured operational data processing.
• Applied backend development, database concepts, API integration, and problem-solving skills to cybersecurity and
information-management requirements.
KEY PROJECTS
• CR Cyber Crime.org — Cybersecurity-focused platform concept supporting cyber-fraud awareness, cybersecurity information, and
structured user-support resources.
• CR-OD Cyber Verify — Document verification concept supporting digital document workflows, verification checks, and structured
information handling.
• CR-OD Career AI — AI-assisted career support concept designed to provide structured career guidance and user-oriented assistance.
• CR-OD Emergency Support — Emergency-support application concept designed to organize assistance information and provide
structured support resources.
• CR-OD Legal PDF — Legal and document workflow concept focused on PDF-based information handling, document organization,
verification-oriented processing, and structured record management.
• CR-OD Nexora — Data-processing and information-management project involving CDR/SDR-related workflows, call-detail records,
tollgate-related records, and structured operational data handling.
EDUCATION
Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.) — Computer Science & Engineering
Gandhi Engineering College, Bhubaneswar
CAREER OBJECTIVE
To build a career in software development, backend engineering, or cybersecurity where I can apply Python, FastAPI, REST API, MySQL,
web development, and problem-solving skills while continuously learning modern technologies and contributing to secure, reliable, and
user-focused software solutions.
ATS KEYWORDS
Python | FastAPI | Django | REST API | Backend Development | Web Development | MySQL | SQL | HTML5 | CSS3 | JavaScript | Tailwind CSS |
Git | GitHub | PDF Processing | Document Verification | Cybersecurity | Cyber Fraud Awareness | CDR | SDR | Call Detail Records | Data
Processing | API Integration
